name: keep-agent
purpose: Functional copy of the orchestrator with frozen instruction files: AGENTS.md only says instructions come from the user, APPEND_SYSTEM.md is empty. Same tools, extensions, /ask, /usage, ledger and dashboard. Calendar and reminder routing are not loaded (shared decision-node state), and it has no Telegram token.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Targeted text replacement in one file.

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: One request, no chat turn: /ask "question". /ask --help lists the flags.

commands.name: /sync
commands.description: Commit ~/.pi and push to origin (use '/sync pull' to only update)

commands.name: /archive
commands.description: Move a file or folder into the archive: /archive <path> · /archive --undo
